svg.desc: IFAO New Library LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT IFAO STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 15 million SAR DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Currently in progress, the IFAO extension in Downtown Cairo spans 2,400 m2 and features a library for rare archaeological documents, along with offices and administrative spaces. Designed to integrate with the existing structure while expressing a modern identity, services include architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, environmental consultancy, and full project management and site supervision.
